6966.title: Provider approval withdrawal is not forwarded
6966.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude bridge removes its local approval waiter on SDK abort without notifying bb, leaving the host/server interaction lifecycle unaware.
6966.proposedFix: Introduce correlated request withdrawal across bridge, runtime, daemon and server, then settle the existing interaction and wake the queue without granting permission.
6966.caveats: The SDK-abort transport gap repeats in two clean trusted checkouts. The live hook, actual MCP result, desktop card and queued follow-up were not exercised. No PR: the fix crosses public lifecycle contracts and subsystems.
